question: The first ICC Men’s T20 Cricket World Cup was won by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The first ICC Men's T20 Cricket World Cup was held in 2007.
 
• India won the inaugural ICC Men's T20 World Cup by defeating Pakistan in the final.
 
• The final match took place on 24th September 2007 at Wanderers Stadium, Johannesburg, South Africa.
 
• India was led by captain MS Dhoni, who played a crucial role in guiding the team to victory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ICC Men's T20 World Cup**

 
 
• The ICC Men's T20 World Cup is an international championship of Twenty20 International cricket.
 
• Organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC), the tournament presently consists of 16 teams, comprising the top 10 teams from the rankings and six other teams chosen through the T20 World Cup Qualifier.
 
• The event has generally been held every two years. However, due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the 2020 edition was rescheduled to 2021.
 
• The format of the tournament includes a group stage, Super 12s, semi-finals, and a final.
 
 
 
• **Twenty20 (T20) Cricket**
 
 
• Twenty20 cricket, also known as T20, is a shortened format of cricket where each team plays a single innings, batting for a maximum of 20 overs.
 
• The format was initially introduced by the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) in 2003 for the inter-county competition in England and Wales.
 
• T20 cricket has gained immense popularity worldwide due to its fast-paced and entertaining nature.
 
• The format has led to the creation of various domestic T20 leagues such as the Indian Premier League (IPL), Big Bash League (BBL), and Caribbean Premier League (CPL).
 
 
 
• **MS Dhoni**
 
 
• Mahendra Singh Dhoni, commonly known as MS Dhoni, is a former Indian cricketer and captain of the Indian national team.
 
• Under his captaincy, India won the 2007 ICC T20 World Cup, the 2010 and 2016 Asia Cups, the 2011 ICC Cricket World Cup, and the 2013 ICC Champions Trophy.
 
• Dhoni is known for his calm demeanor, strategic acumen, and finishing abilities in cricket matches.
 
• He is one of the most successful captains in the history of Indian cricket and has been awarded numerous accolades for his contributions to the sport.
